Definition: a Jitsrite (collectively) or descendants of Jetser
BiblicalUsage: Yitsrîy means a Jitsrite (collectively) or descendants of Jetser. In Numbers 26:49 we read, "Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites."
TheologicalSignificance: Yitsriy is a Jitsrite (collectively) or descendants of Jetser, and it leaves me trusting that God's words are never empty.
